states.title: Home
states.description: Dashboard: engine KPIs, plain-words entry bar, review queue and rule-based nudges.

states.title: Review queue, AI on (later release)
states.description: The queue with the assistant on: a bill-photo draft beside the bank matches. Its amount is the engine's total of the draft; a draft the engine blocks shows none.

states.title: AI and privacy, local (later release)
states.description: On this computer: the model file the user chose (none yet), the runtime not in this build, what each feature sees, and the AI activity log.

states.title: AI and privacy, cloud key (later release)
states.description: Cloud with your own key: the provider as the user described it, the key in the system keychain, redaction, and a confirmation before each document.

states.title: AI and privacy, change provider or key (later release)
states.description: Ctrl+Enter on the cloud panel: endpoint, request format and model as fields, the key in a masked field that is never filled back. Ctrl+A saves the key to the system keychain only; Alt+D deletes it; saving opens no connection.

states.title: Plain-words entry, draft payment (later release)
states.description: The sentence read through the assistant: Rent and the Saptagiri account resolved from the words, 25k copied from them, the date offered as today, the engine's balance check.

states.title: Plain-words entry, unknown name (later release)
states.description: No ledger named Ramesh: the engine blocks the draft and the assistant invents none.

states.title: Plain-words entry, drafting (later release)
states.description: The sentence is with the assistant; nothing is shown until the engine has checked its draft.

states.title: Plain-words entry, rejected (later release)
states.description: Rejected: nothing was posted, and the rejection is in the AI activity log.

states.title: Plain-words entry, ready (later release)
states.description: A model can run: the box has focus and nothing is drafted until Enter.

states.title: Plain-words entry, accepted (later release)
states.description: Ctrl+A posted the draft through the engine; the card says Accepted and names the voucher number the engine gave.

states.title: Plain-words entry, not read (later release)
states.description: The reader refused the answer (a contra voucher; plain words draft payments and receipts only). Nothing is stored as a draft; the failure is in the AI activity log.

states.title: Plain-words entry, no local model (later release)
states.description: On this computer with no model the build can run: the box is disabled, the reason is named, and the voucher forms are offered.

states.title: Bill photo, choose a file (later release)
states.description: Ctrl+Alt+O: the path of a bill photo (PNG or JPEG) or PDF is typed; Enter reads it on this computer. Nothing is read or kept until then.

states.title: Bill photo, reading (later release)
states.description: A bill photo is being read on this computer; the image never leaves the machine.

states.title: Bill photo, choose the purchase ledger (later release)
states.description: What the bill reader reads today: the printed supplier, bill number, date, taxable value, tax and total, drafted as ledger lines with a box on the image for each. The taxable value names no purchase ledger, so the person chooses one; the engine checks the draft after every choice and its verdict is the check line. Item rows are not read yet.

states.title: Bill photo, draft rejected (later release)
states.description: Alt+D: the draft is rejected and nothing is posted; the rejection is in the AI activity log. Another bill can be read, or the bill typed.

states.title: Bill photo, unreadable file (later release)
states.description: The file is a PDF, which this build does not read (PNG photos only); the error says what failed and what to do.

states.title: Home, Hindi
states.description: The default Home with every word the app translates shown in Hindi; figures, dates and digit grouping unchanged.

states.title: Sales invoice, Hindi
states.description: The intra-state item invoice in Hindi.

states.title: Sales invoice, print preview, Hindi
states.description: The print preview chrome in Hindi; the printed page stays English (the PDF font is Latin-only).

states.title: Masters, ledgers, Hindi
states.description: The ledger list in Hindi.

states.title: Balance sheet, Hindi
states.description: The balance sheet in Hindi; Dr and Cr stay as the books write them.

states.title: GSTR-1, Hindi
states.description: GSTR-1 in Hindi; return names and table numbers stay as the portal writes them.

states.title: Bank reconciliation, Hindi
states.description: The bank reconciliation screen in Hindi.

states.title: Import from a file, masters chosen, Hindi
states.description: The import from a file with Masters and Ignore duplicates chosen, in Hindi.

states.title: Import from a file, no choice for existing masters, Hindi
states.description: The missing choice said in Hindi.

states.title: Import from a file, summary and exceptions, Hindi
states.description: The summary and the exceptions list in Hindi; names and the engine's reasons stay as written.

states.title: Import from a file, not an XML file, Hindi
states.description: The unreadable file in Hindi; the engine's reason stays as written.

states.title: Payment, account list open, Hindi
states.description: The payment's cash and bank account list in Hindi.

states.title: First run, welcome, Hindi
states.description: The welcome screen in Hindi.

states.title: Home, company opening
states.description: Skeleton rows while the company file opens and projections load; no figure is shown until the engine returns it.

states.title: Home, new company
states.description: A new company with no vouchers: first steps instead of zero-filled KPIs.

states.title: Home, AI off
states.description: AI tier Off: no AI cards or entry bar, rule-based nudges still shown, top bar says AI off.

states.title: Home, duplicate-bill nudge open
states.description: Anomaly nudge expanded: possible duplicate purchase bill, with rule source and accept, edit, reject.

states.title: Command palette
states.description: Palette over Home with recents, prefixes and key hints; Enter opens on top, Shift+Enter replaces.

states.title: Palette, search 'bal'
states.description: Fuzzy results across reports, ledgers and commands for the fragment 'bal'.

states.title: Palette, voucher number
states.description: The # prefix finds a voucher by number and shows party, date and engine amount.

states.title: Palette, commands
states.description: The > prefix lists commands with their keys.

states.title: Palette, no results
states.description: No match: offers to create a ledger or search vouchers.

states.title: Ask your books, result
states.description: Question compiled to a visible ReportQuery; the engine ran it and renders a drillable table; prose carries no digits.

states.title: Ask your books, building query
states.description: The local model is turning the question into a query; cancellable with Esc.

states.title: Ask your books, ambiguous
states.description: Two readings of 'top customers'; the user picks one before anything runs.

states.title: Ask your books, unsupported
states.description: A forecast question: no report can answer it, so the app says Unsupported and offers related reports.

states.title: Ask your books, AI off
states.description: AI is off for this company; the question box offers the report list and filters instead.

states.title: Sales invoice, intra-state
states.description: F8 item invoice to a Maharashtra party: CGST + SGST recomputed live on every keystroke.

states.title: Sales invoice, inter-state
states.description: Party in Gujarat: place of supply differs, so the engine applies IGST.

states.title: Sales invoice, unregistered buyer
states.description: Cash sale to an unregistered buyer: B2C, no GSTIN, e-invoice not applicable.

states.title: Sales invoice, e-invoice not ready
states.description: A registered buyer whose address has no PIN code: the e-Invoice cell says what the JSON still needs, in the schema's words; nothing is guessed.

states.title: Sales invoice, as voucher
states.description: Ctrl+H, As voucher: ledger lines with the CGST and SGST ledgers chosen; the engine fills the party and tax amounts.

states.title: Sales invoice, change mode
states.description: Ctrl+H opens the list of modes: Item Invoice, Accounting Invoice, As Voucher; Enter or a click picks one.

states.title: Sales invoice, item list open
states.description: Type-ahead over item masters with HSN, rate, GST and stock; Alt+C creates a new item.

states.title: Sales invoice, validation errors
states.description: Missing quantity and an unknown item block saving; each error says where and what to do.

states.title: Sales invoice, period locked
states.description: Date falls on or before the lock date 31 Oct 2026: saving is blocked and the reason is shown.

states.title: Sales invoice, confirm save
states.description: Enter on the last field asks to save; Ctrl+A saves from anywhere.

states.title: Sales invoice, saved
states.description: A fresh invoice opens after saving, with a toast naming the voucher saved.

states.title: Bill photo, choose a file
states.description: Ctrl+Alt+O: the path of a bill photo (PNG or JPEG) or PDF is typed; Enter reads it on this computer. Nothing is read or kept until then.

states.title: Bill photo, choose the purchase ledger
states.description: What the bill reader reads today: the printed supplier, bill number, date, taxable value, tax and total, drafted as ledger lines with a box on the image for each. The taxable value names no purchase ledger, so the person chooses one; the engine checks the draft after every choice and its verdict is the check line. Item rows are not read yet.

states.title: Bill photo, draft rejected
states.description: Alt+D: the draft is rejected and nothing is posted; the rejection is in the AI activity log. Another bill can be read, or the bill typed.

states.title: Bill photo, reading
states.description: A bill photo is being read on this computer; the image never leaves the machine.

states.title: Bill photo, draft purchase
states.description: Draft purchase voucher from a bill photo: transcribed fields with boxes on the image, engine totals and checks.

states.title: Bill photo, field left blank
states.description: One rate could not be read with enough confidence, so it is blank and Accept waits for it.

states.title: Bill photo, total mismatch
states.description: Printed total differs from the engine total of the lines; Accept is blocked until resolved.

states.title: Bill photo, possible duplicate
states.description: Same supplier and bill number already posted; the draft shows the existing voucher.

states.title: Bill photo, AI off
states.description: Bill reading is off for this company; the purchase form stays available with the image beside it.

states.title: Bill photo, cloud consent
states.description: Local reading was weak; the user may send this one image to their own cloud key, with redaction listed.

states.title: Bill photo, unreadable file
states.description: The file is a PDF, which this build does not read (PNG photos only); the error says what failed and what to do.

states.title: Bill photo, accepted
states.description: The draft is posted as PB/0145 after the human accepted it; the audit note records the AI source.

states.title: Plain-words entry, draft payment
states.description: 'paid rent 25k to Sharma Properties from Saptagiri' becomes a draft payment with each value traced.

states.title: Plain-words entry, Hinglish
states.description: Hinglish text becomes a draft receipt against an open bill and links the matching bank line.

states.title: Plain-words entry, unknown name
states.description: No ledger named 'Ramesh': the draft refuses to invent one and asks to pick or create.

states.title: Plain-words entry, drafting
states.description: The local model is drafting; the text stays editable and Esc cancels.

states.title: Plain-words entry, rejected
states.description: The user rejected the draft; nothing was posted and an optional reason is asked.

states.title: Payment
states.description: F5 payment in single-entry style: bank balance now and after saving.

states.title: Payment, account list open
states.description: A fresh payment with the keyboard on Account: the list under the field holds only the cash and bank ledgers (Cash-in-hand, Bank accounts, Bank OD) and the form stays in view.

states.title: Payment, bill allocation
states.description: Paying a supplier pops the bill-wise allocation with open bills from the engine.

states.title: Payment, overdraft warning
states.description: Amount exceeds the bank balance: a warning, with the shortfall computed by the engine.

states.title: Receipt
states.description: F6 receipt against an open sales bill.

states.title: Balance sheet
states.description: Condensed balance sheet as at 20 Nov 2026 with a 'both sides agree' check.

states.title: Balance sheet, detailed
states.description: Alt+F1 expands every group to ledgers.

states.title: Balance sheet, group drill
states.description: Drilled into Sundry debtors: ledgers with balances that sum to the group figure.

states.title: Balance sheet, ledger vouchers
states.description: Shree Ganesh Traders: opening, vouchers and running balance.

states.title: Balance sheet, voucher, e-invoice exported
states.description: Ctrl+E on a saved sales invoice wrote its e-invoice JSON (INV-01) to a file; a note says where. Upload is done by the user on the government portal.

states.title: Balance sheet, voucher
states.description: Voucher SI/0412 read-only, with its audit line.

states.title: Balance sheet, computing
states.description: Report is computing; cancellable; the last result is never shown as current.

states.title: Balance sheet, provisional stock
states.description: Negative stock makes closing stock Provisional; the figure is marked and explained, never silently used.

states.title: Day book
states.description: Vouchers for 20 Nov 2026, with who entered them and whether a draft came from AI.

states.title: Day book, 1 to 20 Nov
states.description: Period view of every November voucher.

states.title: Day book, no vouchers
states.description: 21 Nov 2026 has no vouchers yet; offers voucher keys.

states.title: GSTR-1, November
states.description: Sections built from sales vouchers with exception buckets: Ready, Not relevant, Mismatch, Needs correction.

states.title: GSTR-1, needs correction
states.description: An item with no HSN code holds back the HSN summary; drill to the master to fix.

states.title: GSTR-3B working, November
states.description: Outward tax, ITC from accepted 2B records and engine set-off; books vs portal columns.

states.title: 2B and IMS reconciliation
states.description: Engine match status per 2B record and a suggested IMS action the user must confirm.

states.title: 2B mismatch explained
states.description: AI explanation of a value difference, with engine-bound figures and a draft fix.

states.title: 2B reconciliation, nothing imported
states.description: No 2B/IMS file for November yet; explains how to import the downloaded JSON.

states.title: 2B reconciliation, import failed
states.description: The file is for another GSTIN; nothing is imported and the reason is shown.

states.title: 2B reconciliation, October final
states.description: GSTR-3B for October is filed, so IMS actions for October are final and read-only.

states.title: Bank reconciliation
states.description: Statement lines with Exact, Rule, AI-suggested and unmatched status.

states.title: Bank, AI suggestions
states.description: Filtered to AI suggestions; the selected line shows its proposal, reason and confidence.

states.title: Bank, suggested new ledger
states.description: Lines with no fitting ledger: a proposal to create one, built from the narrations.

states.title: Bank, no statement
states.description: No statement imported for this account; import from CSV, XLSX or MT940.

states.title: Bank, balance check failed
states.description: Opening plus lines does not equal the closing balance in the file; the import is refused.

states.title: Bank, AI off
states.description: Only exact and rule matches; leftover lines wait for manual matching.

states.title: Bank reconciliation statement
states.description: Balance as per books, each entry the bank has not cleared under its total, the balance as per bank, the statement's balance and the difference.

states.title: Bank reconciliation statement, exported
states.description: Ctrl+E wrote the statement to a CSV or XLSX file; a note says where it went.

states.title: Masters, ledgers
states.description: Ledgers by group with engine balances; filter as you type.

states.title: Masters, party detail
states.description: Party ledger: GSTIN with check, state, credit days, open bills.

states.title: Masters, stock items
states.description: Items with HSN, GST rate, stock and value from the stock engine.

states.title: Masters, create ledger
states.description: Create a party ledger; GSTIN fills the state and checks the check character.

states.title: Masters, GSTIN invalid
states.description: Check character is wrong; the error says which character was expected.

states.title: Masters, suggested ledger
states.description: A proposed ledger from bank narrations, with source lines and accept, edit, reject.

states.title: Review queue
states.description: Every open proposal from every source in one list; J/K to move, Y/N to decide.

states.title: Review queue, empty
states.description: Nothing waiting for review.

states.title: Keyboard map, classic preset
states.description: Full keyboard map with the classic accountant keys preset.

states.title: Keyboard map, standard preset
states.description: Same map with the standard desktop preset (Ctrl+S, Ctrl+N).

states.title: First run, welcome
states.description: Create a company, import from another app, open a file or try the sample.

states.title: Setup, company details
states.description: Name, GSTIN (fills state), financial year April to March, books begin date.

states.title: Setup, GSTIN error
states.description: GSTIN state code does not match the chosen state; the fix is named.

states.title: Setup, features
states.description: Inventory, GST, bank reconciliation, e-invoice JSON: each explained in one line.

states.title: Setup, keyboard preset
states.description: Classic accountant keys (default) or standard desktop keys, with a preview.

states.title: Setup, AI and privacy
states.description: Off is selected. On this computer and Cloud are shown disabled, tagged Not in this release; AI arrives in a later version.

states.title: Setup, backup
states.description: Daily backup folder and the note on keeping a copy on storage in India.

states.title: Setup, done
states.description: Company created; the first three things to do, each with its key.

states.title: AI and privacy, off
states.description: Off is selected; On this computer and Cloud are disabled, tagged Not in this release. Every AI entry point is hidden; rule checks and engine matching still work.

states.title: Masters, new stock item
states.description: The stock item form: name, alias, under, unit, valuation, HSN/SAC and batches; Save needs a unit.

states.title: Home, new tab with a company open
states.description: Ctrl+T with a company open opens Home in a second tab; the tab strip shows both, New tab and Close tab.

states.title: Profit and loss, not printed
states.description: The PDF could not be made from the engine answer; the reason is said in words, the report stays on screen and nothing is written.

states.title: Profit and loss, print settings
states.description: The print preview with the settings changed: A5 paper, 2 copies, Pages to print and First page number set; the page and the facts beside it follow.

states.title: Profit and loss, pages to print past the end
states.description: Pages to print names a page the document does not have; the settings are refused in words, the preview keeps the last good pages and nothing is written.

states.title: Sales invoice, print preview
states.description: Ctrl+P on a saved invoice shows the tax invoice page as it will print, with the print settings and Save as PDF.

states.title: Day book, print preview
states.description: Ctrl+P shows the day book as it will print: date, voucher type, number, particulars and amount, without the audit columns.

states.title: Journal, print preview
states.description: Ctrl+P on a saved voucher without a tax invoice (journal, and likewise payment, receipt, contra and purchase) shows the voucher page: particulars with debit and credit, total and narration.

states.title: GSTR-1, sections could not be built
states.description: The engine could not build the GSTR-1 sections; the error is said in words and no table is shown.

states.title: Home, GST tile not readable
states.description: The GST cash payable tile says Needs GSTR-2B and not readable yet; no figure is shown.

states.title: Profit and loss, computing
states.description: Report computing; Esc cancels; the last result is not shown as current.

states.title: Profit and loss, preparing the PDF
states.description: Ctrl+P was pressed and the PDF is being rendered; the preview opens when it is ready.

states.title: Trial balance, computing
states.description: Report computing; Esc cancels; no ledger figure is shown before the engine answers.

states.title: Outstanding receivables, computing
states.description: Bill-wise report computing; Esc cancels; the last result is not shown as current.

states.title: Stock summary, computing
states.description: Quantities and values computing from the stock engine; no figure is shown before it answers.

states.title: Audit, reading the log
states.description: The audit log is being read; nothing from it is shown yet.

states.title: Audit, log could not be read
states.description: The log could not be read (company file open elsewhere); the failure is said in words and nothing is shown from it.

states.title: GSTR-1, not loaded for this period
states.description: Feed not loaded: says Not loaded for this period yet and shows no sections.

states.title: GSTR-3B, not loaded for this period
states.description: Feed not loaded: says Not loaded for this period yet and shows no table.

states.title: GSTR-1, not supported in this build
states.description: The engine refuses the GSTR-1 feed; the reason is said in words (Not supported yet: what, reason).

states.title: GSTR-3B, not supported in this build
states.description: The engine refuses the GSTR-3B liability; the reason is said in words, and no cash figure is shown.

states.title: Masters, no ledgers yet
states.description: A new company with no ledgers: the empty state offers Create ledger (Alt+C).

states.title: Masters, no stock items yet
states.description: No stock items: the empty state offers Create stock item (Alt+C); that form is not in the mock.

states.title: Masters, balances loading
states.description: Ledger names are listed; the balance column shows dashes until the engine returns the balances.

states.title: Masters, filter matches nothing
states.description: The filter has no match: the line says No ledgers matches, with the filter text.

states.title: Import from another app
states.description: One-step import with host, port and company, the import from an XML file with nothing chosen yet, and the step-by-step panel shown as not connected.

states.title: Import, no company open
states.description: No company is open: says to create one first, offers Back to setup, and both the one-step form and the import from a file are disabled with the reason.

states.title: Import, company name missing
states.description: The company name is empty; the reason is said in words and nothing is imported.

states.title: Import, port not a number in range
states.description: Port 99999 is outside 1 to 65535; the reason is said in words.

states.title: Import, running
states.description: Importing; the button is disabled and the form stays as typed.

states.title: Import, finished with a summary
states.description: The engine reports the company read, the events committed and any warnings (sample counts).

states.title: Import, refused as not supported
states.description: The engine refuses a voucher type; the refusal names what and why.

states.title: Import from a file, masters chosen
states.description: Alt+O: Masters chosen, the three choices for a master already in the company (Ignore duplicates picked) and the file path filled; nothing imported yet.

states.title: Import from a file, no choice for existing masters
states.description: Masters chosen but no choice for a master already in the company: the reason is said in words and nothing is imported.

states.title: Import from a file, summary and exceptions
states.description: The file was read: 2 created, 1 not imported, with every object not imported listed beside its reason.

states.title: Import from a file, not an XML file
states.description: The file is not an XML document: the error names the file and the cause, and nothing is imported.

states.title: Import, failed with a reason
states.description: The other app could not be read; the error names the company, the host and port, and the cause. Nothing is written.

states.title: Cold start, new tab
states.description: Ctrl+T with no company open opens a second Company setup tab; the tab strip shows both and New tab and Close tab.

states.title: Cold start, sidebar collapsed to the rail
states.description: Ctrl+\ folds the sidebar to its 60 px rail: icons only, labels hidden.

states.title: Purchase, typed by hand
states.description: F9 purchase with no bill photo: supplier bill, item lines and IGST computed by the engine (Nilgiri in Karnataka, place of supply Maharashtra, so IGST).

states.title: Purchase, validation errors
states.description: A missing quantity and an unknown item block saving; each error names its line and the fix.

states.title: Credit note against SI/0412
states.description: Sales return of 10 sets of brass nozzles to Shree Ganesh Traders: CGST and SGST reversed, reference to the invoice kept.

states.title: Credit note, quantity missing
states.description: A line with an item and no quantity: the note cannot be saved, the line says so and the tax stays Not computed.

states.title: Debit note against RP/5398
states.description: Purchase return to Rupa Polymers: 2 coils of HDPE pipe at the bill's rate, IGST 18% computed by the engine, note number DN/0001.

states.title: Debit note, quantity missing
states.description: A line with an item and no quantity: the note cannot be saved, the line says so and the tax stays Not computed.

states.title: Journal, reclassify freight
states.description: JV/0033 moves freight paid from Purchases to Freight inward: debits and credits both 1,840.00.

states.title: Journal, does not balance
states.description: Debits 1,840.00 against credits 1,480.00: the difference is shown and Save stays blocked.

states.title: Contra, cash to bank
states.description: CT/0022: 30,000.00 cash paid into the Saptagiri account; the cash balance after saving comes from the engine.

states.title: Contra, no account and zero amount
states.description: Neither account is picked and the amount is zero: both errors shown, Save blocked.

states.title: Choose bank account
states.description: Two bank accounts: balances per books and whether a statement is imported, with Enter to open the one selected.

states.title: Start, recent companies
states.description: The app opens with the recent company list (Godavari) and the create, import and open actions.

states.title: Profit and loss
states.description: Trading account (opening stock, purchases, direct expenses, gross profit against sales and closing stock) then profit and loss, by group; net profit equals the balance sheet's profit to date.

states.title: Profit and loss, provisional stock
states.description: A quantity below zero makes the closing stock Provisional; the figure is kept and marked, with the reason and a way to fix it.

states.title: Profit and loss, detailed
states.description: Alt+F1 shows the ledgers under each group of the trading account and the profit and loss account.

states.title: Profit and loss, print preview
states.description: Ctrl+P shows the page as it will print, with Save as PDF; paper printing is not offered.

states.title: Profit and loss, PDF saved
states.description: The PDF is written and the screen says where, with an Open file action.

states.title: Profit and loss, PDF not saved
states.description: The file is open in another program: nothing is written, and the screen says so and how to retry.

states.title: Trial balance
states.description: The sample company's ledgers with a balance, debit and credit columns totalling the same, checked by the engine.

states.title: Bills receivable
states.description: Open customer bills with bill date, due date from credit days, open amount and overdue days.

states.title: Bills payable
states.description: Open supplier bills, including the Kaveri and Nilgiri bills, with due dates and overdue days.

states.title: Stock summary
states.description: Each item with quantity from the stock engine, cost and value; the total is the balance sheet's closing stock.

states.title: Stock summary, provisional item
states.description: Steel pickaxe went 30 nos below zero on 19 Nov and is back to 70: its value is kept and marked Provisional, and so is the total.

states.title: Audit, edit log
states.description: The engine's edit log for 1 to 20 Nov: one line per posted voucher with Seq, Date, Time, User, Action, Object, Reason, Field, Before, After; read-only.

states.title: Audit, integrity certificate
states.description: Vouchers checked against the log and the count of broken hash links.

states.title: Audit, edits after lock
states.description: The engine's edits-after-lock table, empty: every voucher was posted before the books were locked, so none is listed.
